prompt: What may be missing in a photo taken through the clear sleeve?
promptZh: 直接隔著透明套拍照，照片可能漏掉什麼？

options.whyZh: 被折處遮住的是鉛筆註記，不是墨水字。

options.text: The printed name of the recipe.
options.whyZh: 沒有說食譜印有名稱或名稱被擋住。
要掀開折處才能看到鉛筆註記，透明套會把它壓住。

options.text: The size of the larger pan stamped on the card.
options.zh: 卡片上蓋印的大烤盤尺寸。
options.whyZh: 沒有說卡片上有尺寸印記。

explanationZh: 要掀開折處才能看到鉛筆註記，透明套會把它壓住。
evidence: That recipe card has two times on it. Grandma wrote twenty minutes in ink, and Dad wrote fifteen in pencil below it. Which one goes into our booklet? / I was planning to photograph the card first. I can see the pencil note if I lift the fold, but the clear sleeve presses it closed.
